## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-7c312db6)

## Summary

REV34-DIALOGUX: makes HTDT's dialog/wizard layer and first-run path self-explanatory for Japanese users — the surfaces REV32/33 deliberately skipped (the wheel-scroll guard excludes dialogs by design and the tooltip sweep covered only page widgets).

**Dialog tooltip sweep (18 files):** every QDialog/QWizard/secondary window in `backend/src/htdt` (equipment library, playback-chain dialog, commissioning wizard, geometry import, deliverables, standards profile editor, system expansion, capture receiver settings, command palette, workflow help/settings, authority inspector, room prediction/video/workspace, solver diagnostics) now carries JA tooltips on its interactive controls — field + QFormLayout label + embedded `QAbstractSpinBox.lineEdit()` (setToolTip does not reach it) via the new shared `apply_field_tooltip(field, tip, form)` helper in `field_tooltips.py`. Units and valid ranges included where relevant (e.g. `1–32 Ω`, `0.1–20 m`); `QTabWidget`s get `setTabToolTip`.

![JA tooltip live in equipment library dialog](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..nbjHtPKQmrhP5NbwcLUtlwkyBu6JRtsfkuW82tfv0yQ)

**Wheel-scroll guard — decided to keep as-is:** the `QApplication`-level `WheelScrollGuard` already guards combo/spin boxes inside dialog scroll areas (no code carve-out ever existed); verified empirically and locked in with two regression tests. Controls in fixed, non-scrolling dialogs keep Qt's default wheel-adjust deliberately — now documented in the module docstring.

**First-run fixes:** an empty scene reports either VTK's `±1` sentinel bounds (extent 2.0 → ~0.56 m camera frame) or a degenerate `~1e-9` extent from overlay-only actors, so first-run room sketching happened at sub-millimetre/nanometre scale — drawing was effectively impossible. New `reset_camera_or_floor_default` in `room_viewport.py` substitutes `DEFAULT_EMPTY_SCENE_BOUNDS` (a typical-room floor patch) whenever the scene lacks usable bounds — applied to the workflow viewport, the room-geometry sketch entry, and all five view ops (`_top`/`_front`/`_right`/`_perspective`/`_fit`) in `native_editor.py`. Before/after of the same empty data dir:

![BEFORE: ruler at 1.86e-09 m — sketching impossible](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..708K281vRZRM58hPGdl3iqTIOxxY0FAgd42lLZe444M)
![AFTER: room committed at real metre scale](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..hyTAJG57K44--ZHR3jU8ag7gO8C1LVPDH8SaEkk4C-Y)

Sketch close on both sketch paths (`room_geometry_input.py`, `room_editor.py`) now names the two drawable failures in Japanese — stacked vertices and self-intersecting outline — instead of the generic 「データを処理できませんでした」 fallback (domain exceptions stay English per `user_facing_error._map_exception`, so the UI pre-validates). Verified live on a bowtie outline:

![Self-intersecting outline rejected with JA message](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._pfgUkxXalT5d5oYnWDEdvDj_dh1cKHC_uHgPT3YCZg)

**Keyboard sanity:** focus-chain audit of the heaviest dialogs found `PlaybackChainDialog` opening on its `QTabBar` (arrow keys switched tabs instead of editing); it now focuses `amp_label` on open — regression test added. All other audited dialogs either delegate to `prepare_to_show` (command palette) or have acceptable tab order.

**Tests:** new `test_dialog_ux.py` (focus) + 8 new/updated cases across `test_room_cadux.py` (empty/degenerate/sentinel bounds → floor-default, sketch rejections) and `test_wheel_scroll_guard.py` (dialog-scroll-area coverage). Scoped suite green on the merged tree: `test_room_cadux`, `test_wheel_scroll_guard`, `test_dialog_ux`, `test_room_workspace`, `test_room_journey`, `test_geometry_import_dialog`, `test_workflow_help` (86 passed, `-n 4` offscreen).

Empty-state audit note: all sidebar surfaces (概要/部屋/測定/最適化/プロジェクト/取り込み/アクティビティ/ライブラリ/サポート/設定) already say what they are and what to do next — verified, no changes needed there beyond the camera fix. Unsaved-changes guard was also exercised (4-option JA dialog).
